title: GPU ChaCha20 and Box-Muller AWGN kernel
description:
## Goal

Device-side ChaCha20 kernel + Box-Muller AWGN sampler producing
byte-identical noise stream to the host ChaCha20 partitioning
scheme at the same seed and per-worker `set_word_pos` offset.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline)
within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] GPU ChaCha20 kernel output matches host
  `ChaCha20Rng::set_word_pos(N)` stream bit-for-bit at fixed
  seed + offset; AWGN samples match within documented FP
  tolerance.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: receipt records GPU
  noise-generation throughput vs single-thread CPU baseline on
  gfx1030.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
